name: lidl-de-products-scraper
title: Lidl.de Product Scraper
description: Collect product data from Lidl.de: SKU, GTIN, name, brand, price, availability, rating, images, description and category. Pay per product.
readme:
# Lidl.de Product Scraper Collect product data from the Lidl.de online shop. Each row is one product with its article number, GTIN, name, brand, price in EUR, availability, rating, review count, images, description and category. You pay per product delivered. The data comes from the public product pages of [Lidl.de](https://www.lidl.de/), which the shop lists in its public product list. No account and no API key are needed. ## What you get For each product the actor returns one row with: - `sku`, `url`: the Lidl article number and the product page - `gtin13`, `gtins`: the first GTIN (EAN-13) and all GTINs the page lists (products with sizes or colours list one per variant) - `name`, `brand` - `price`, `currency`: the price shown on the page, in EUR - `availability`: the value the page gives, for example `OnlineOnly` - `rating`, `ratingCount`, `reviewCount` - `images`: image addresses - `description`, `descriptionHtml`: the description as plain text and as the page prints it - `category`, `categoryPath`: the category of the product, for example Mode / Damenmode / Röcke / Mini-Röcke - `shippingCost`: the home delivery charge the page shows - `scrapedAt` A value the page does not show is null (lists are empty). ## Typical uses - Keep a price and availability snapshot of the Lidl.de assortment - Match Lidl article numbers and GTINs against your own catalogue - Track ratings and review counts of own-brand products - Build a product feed for a comparison site or a spreadsheet ## Pricing You pay per product delivered, plus a small fee for each run. | Event | Name | Price | |---|---|---| | Run start (charged once, together with the first delivered row) | `actor-start` | $0.001 per run | | One product row | `product-result` | $0.0019 per product | A run that finds nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost for the run, the actor stops cleanly once the next row would go over it. **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough for a first test run before you pay anything. ## Input | Field | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `startUrls` | list | none | Lidl.de product addresses to read. When set, the keyword is ignored | | `keyword` | list | none | Words that must appear in the product address. Several words in one entry must all appear, several entries are alternatives | | `maxResults` | number | 100 | Maximum products in total, up to 20,000 | How it works: - Without `startUrls`, the actor reads the shop's public product list (about 14,000 products, in the order of the list) and opens the product pages one after the other. - `keyword` filters that list by the product address, which holds the product name. The filter runs on the list, so a keyword does not start a search on the shop. Write words the way addresses are written: `weisswein`, `damen`, `fahrrad`. - The list covers the non-food assortment and wine. Weekly food offers and the shop's search are not read. - A product that appears twice is delivered once. - Number fields also accept numbers written as text, for example `"50"`. - Started with no input, the actor returns the first 100 products of the list. ### Example: women's clothing ```json { "keyword": ["damen"], "maxResults": 30 } ``` ### Example: two products by address ```json { "startUrls": [ "https://www.lidl.de/p/crivit-damen-funktionstights/p100406558", "https://www.lidl.de/p/esmara-damen-pailletten-minirock/p100396330" ] } ``` ## Output sample ```json { "sku": "100406558", "gtin13": "4054599193731", "gtins": ["4054599193731", "4054599193748", "4054599193755"], "name": "Damen Funktionstights", "brand": "CRIVIT", "price": 7.99, "currency": "EUR", "availability": "OnlineOnly", "rating": 4.9, "ratingCount": 20, "reviewCount": 20, "images": ["https://www.lidl.de/assets/gcp0dda47d17689465aac5157c19493153f.jpg"], "description": "Damen Funktionstights von CRIVIT - sportliche Trainingshose für Fitness und Alltag", "descriptionHtml": "

Damen Funktionstights von CRIVIT ...

", "category": "Sport Hosen", "categoryPath": ["Mode", "Damenmode", "Damen Sportbekleidung", "Sport Hosen"], "shippingCost": 5.95, "url": "https://www.lidl.de/p/crivit-damen-funktionstights/p100406558", "scrapedAt": "2026-11-12T10:00:00Z" } ``` ## Limitations - Only products in the shop's public product list can be found by keyword. Products you know by address can be read with `startUrls`. - The product list does not say when a product changed, so a run always reads pages again. Keep your own history if you need changes over time. - Price and availability are those the page shows at the time of the run. Lidl prices can differ between the website and the stores. - `gtin13` is the first GTIN. Products with several variants list all of them in `gtins`, without a label for which variant each belongs to. - A product page that no longer exists is skipped and not charged. - If the source keeps refusing, the run stops with a status that says so, and only delivered rows are charged. ## FAQ **Do I need a Lidl account?** No. The actor reads public pages. **Does it read the weekly food offers or the shop search?** No. It reads the product pages from the public product list, and the product pages you give in `startUrls`. **Why did I get fewer rows than `maxResults`?** The keyword matched fewer products, or the maximum cost you set for the run was reached. The run status message says which. **Can a keyword be in English?** The addresses are German, so use German words such as `damen`, `herren`, `weisswein` or `fahrrad`. **Can one product show up twice?** No. Rows are unique by article number within a run. **Can a run be restarted safely?** Yes. Progress is saved after every batch. A restarted run continues where it stopped and does not deliver or charge the same rows twice. **Is this affiliated with Lidl?** No. This is an independent tool that reads public data. Please keep your use modest and in line with the terms of the source. ## Use with AI agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex. **MCP server URL:** ``` https://mcp.apify.com?tools=nanodata/lidl-de-products-scraper ``` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `lidl-de-products-scraper` to list 30 products from a Lidl Germany category with price and rating. Return results as a table." ## Related Actors - [ALDI Australia Products Scraper](https://apify.com/nanodata/aldi-au-products-scraper): Collect products from the ALDI Australia catalogue: name, brand, price, unit price, pack size, category, images and special-buy flags. - [Amazon Product Scraper by ASIN: Price, Stock & Reviews](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/amazon-product-scraper): Scrape Amazon ASINs or product URLs in 20 marketplaces: price, list price, stock, rating, star breakdown, monthly purchase volume, variants, bestseller ranks, A+ content and hi-res images. - [eBay Product Scraper · 8 Marketplaces](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/ebay-scraper): Scrape eBay active listings by keyword or URL. ## Support Found a problem or need a field added? Open an issue on the [Issues tab](https://apify.com/nanodata/lidl-de-products-scraper/issues). We usually reply within one business day. You can also email contact@nanoscrape.com.
